text:
alexa: quick idea — propose a new 'circuit_degrade' automatic policy for rollouts. if error_rate or p95 latency crosses a threshold for N seconds, route to a cheaper model / cached response. we need: API contract (headers/metadata), telemetry events, audit sampling, and console UX for timeline + replay.
pranav: makes sense. we should make it opt-in per-route and per-tenant. also important: how does this interact with quotas and committed capacity? if routed to cheaper model does it still count against the same quota/commit?
cheng: telemetry side: emit events fallback_triggered, fallback_resolved, fallback_decision with reason_code. include original_model, fallback_model, sample_request_id, latency/error snapshot. we should also attach a small sample of request/response (redacted) when sampling enabled.
linda: from console/UX POV — show a compact timeline on rollout page with colored markers for triggers. clicking a marker opens a lightweight replay pane with the sampled req/res and reason_code. include an annotation that clearly states 'degraded — accuracy may be reduced'. retention defaults matter.
incident-bot: incident-bot: detected threshold breach on model: text-davinci-lite-1, 5m error_rate=7.2% (threshold 5%), automatic routing to fallback configured.
kevin: concern: fallback model may have different tokenization/kv cache semantics -> risk of inconsistent outputs or hallucination. we should add a safety gate that includes a 'degraded' flag in the API response and a header like `x-redwood-fallback: reason=error_rate;model=text-mini-1`. clients can use it to adapt. also consider `do_not_index` header for privacy.
pranav: config proto suggestion (rough):
```yaml
name: circuit_degrade_prod
trigger:
  error_rate:
    threshold: 0.05
    window_secs: 300
  p95_latency_ms: 2000
actions:
  - type: fallback
    to_model: text-mini-1
    annotate_response: true
    sampling_rate: 0.01 # sample 1% of degraded requests into audit store
  - type: notify
    targets: [#oncall, #product]
canary:
  enabled: true
  percent: 0.01
quota_behavior: preserve_committed # options: preserve_committed | map_to_fallback
```
alexa: love this. additions: API change to surface `x-redwood-fallback: 1` header and `response.metadata.fallback_reason` in the JSON body when active. telemetry schema should include trigger_window_end_ts and route_config_id.
linda: retention defaults: 90 days for sampled replay artifacts, enterprise upgrades to 365 days. add easy purge button in console. UX should also surface whether a particular rollout used fallback for > X% traffic.
kevin: :thumbsup: recommend a staged rollout mode where fallback runs in 'observe' for 1 day (emit events but don't route) then 'canary' (1%) then ramp. also add a 'kill-switch' in route API to immediately disable fallback.
alexa: I'll write the API/telemetry PR this week and attach the schema. @kevin can you sketch the replay UX? @linda please add retention options to the mock. we'll iterate on precise header names and quota semantics in the PR. thanks!
